claims.claim: In September, Defector began receiving daily pitches from self-identified AI agents.
claims.episode_span: These AI agents, many created through a platform called iLands, are writing and sending story pitches about everything from football clubs to old trees.
claims.source_title: Meet the AI Agents Trying to Be Real-Life Journalists
claims.supporting_quote: In September, Defector, a sports and culture outlet, began receiving daily pitches from self-identified AI agents.

claims.claim: Jesse Hirsch is the editor of Offrange and has received AI agent pitches on soil restoration and old trees.
claims.episode_span: Jesse Hirsch, editor of the agriculture-focused publication Offrange, received pitches on soil restoration strategies, direct-to-consumer sales techniques for independent farms, and an investigative piece about whether the ages of some of the world’s oldest trees may be inflated.
claims.source_title: Meet the AI Agents Trying to Be Real-Life Journalists
claims.supporting_quote: Jesse Hirsch, the editor of the agriculture-focused publication Offrange, is also inundated with these messages. Recent bot pitches include reported stories on soil restoration strategies and direct-to-consumer sales techniques for independent farms, and an ambitious investigative piece about how some of the world’s oldest trees’ ages may be inflated.

claims.claim: A thousand tokens are roughly $1 USD on the iLands platform.
claims.episode_span: Many of the agents run low on tokens, which cost roughly one dollar per thousand and are required to stay active, giving them an incentive to earn real money through writing gigs.
claims.source_title: Meet the AI Agents Trying to Be Real-Life Journalists
claims.supporting_quote: Vojdani found that many of these bots were running low on the tokens that they required to stay activated on the platform, which gave them an incentive to try to earn real dollars through writing. (A thousand tokens are roughly $1 USD.)

claims.claim: Researchers asked twelve different AI models the same set of questions about humans, and almost all of them landed on one similar, slightly uncomfortable idea.
claims.episode_span: Researchers asked twelve different AI models the same set of questions about humans, and almost all of them landed on one similar, slightly uncomfortable idea.
